text:
luca: Quick sync — proposed acceptance criteria and feedback path for the upcoming partner pilot. Short version: 1) cohort of 8-12 partners, 2) onboarding completion >= 75% within 14 days, 3) no P0 regressions for 7 days, 4) structured feedback routed into Product/ML/Eng queues. Thoughts?
aj: Agree with the high level. Two operational caveats: capacity — we should cap concurrent heavy-load partners to 4 until Dedicated autoscaling is validated. Also we need a concrete list of test prompts per partner before they get accepted.
emily: +1. I'll own the test-prompt pack. Suggest we require each partner to run 10 canonical prompts covering long-context, tool-calls, and embeddings within the first week. That gives us signal on latency, correctness, and embeddings drift.
kenji: Legal and data handling note: add a checkbox for PII/workload isolation in onboarding. If a partner wants private VPC access, mark them as "private-preview" and route them to Ops.
maria: For success metrics, propose: NPS >= 6/10 at week 2, weekly active usage > 500 tokens/day for at least half the cohort, and at least one actionable change (bug/regression/feature) per partner captured in the feedback pipeline. Also, include a qualitative "value found" interview for top 4 partners.
product-bot: Template: https://internal.redwood/apply/pilot-template — use the "partner intake" form. Auto-tags on submission: region, workload-type, wants-private.
aj: Re: feedback routing — can we use a triage rule set? e.g., keyword match for "accuracy/regression" -> ML queue, "latency/crash" -> Eng-runtime, "UX/clarity" -> Product. Weekly digest goes to a single thread.
emily: We should attach a minimal eval harness to each partner workspace. A small script that runs their prompt pack daily and posts metrics (latency, top-1 repetitiveness, embedding similarity drift). I can pair with eng-runtime on the basic infra.
kenji: Compensation and incentives — recommend a $1k credit + 3 months of dedicated support for high-signal partners. Legal will need standard data processing addendum before we activate credits.
luca: Launch gating proposal: soft private preview if >=3 partners pass onboarding + no P0 for 7 days. Move to broader private preview after 10 partners with NPS threshold met and automated eval passing. Is that too conservative?
maria: Sounds reasonable. Also add rollback criteria: any repeatable P1 within 72 hours triggers canary rollback and immediate incident review.
aj: Operational checklist before acceptance: onboarding doc, test-prompt pack, infra whitelist, monitoring hooks (trace + kv cache hit rate), and trial SLA agreed.
emily: I'll drop the test-prompt template in the intake form and add the eval harness README. Expect PR by EOD tomorrow.
luca: Thanks — who will be the primary channel for partner-facing comms? I can do intro + kickoff, but need someone to run weekly syncs.
maria: I'll own the weekly syncs and the partner scorecard. I'll also run the first two "value found" interviews.
kenji: I'll track legal/KMS gating and mark partners that need private deployment.
aj: I'll set up the triage automation rules and weekly digest channel (product-pilot-feedback).
product-bot: Reminder: Please fill intake form for any new partner before scheduling kickoff.
luca: Perfect. I'll update the pilot plan doc with these acceptance gates and send the recruitment invite later today. :thumbsup:
